official.deadline_note: No single closing date is published. The OAS announcement states rolling admission for CSU bachelor's programmes, that graduate admission deadlines vary by programme, and directs Impact MBA applicants to contact CSU directly.
official.application_cycle: Fall 2027 entry - only newly admitted students for Fall 2027 are considered at this time
official.status_note: CSU is taking the OAS Scholarship Application from eligible newly admitted international students for Fall 2027; the OAS lists the OAS - Colorado State University programme among its 2026 open announcements (PAEC, onsite, United States).
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published wording: 'OAS scholarship recipients will receive 1/3 off non-resident tuition for all degree seeking on-campus program.'
benefits: One third off non-resident tuition for all degree-seeking on-campus programmes at the Fort Collins campus
No application fee for OAS applicants (stated for the Impact MBA route)
May be combined with other scholarships, but not combinable with a graduate assistantship
The Impact MBA starts annually in August; acceptance into the MBA precedes scholarship consideration
eligibility: Citizen or permanent resident of one of the 32 listed OAS member economies (Canada and Mexico included; the United States is not eligible)
Admitted to a degree-seeking, on-campus programme at Colorado State University's Fort Collins campus; only newly admitted students for Fall 2027 are considered
Transfer undergraduate or graduate student - new, first-year students are not eligible
Students admitted to the SPUR campus are not eligible (already paying discounted tuition)
Students awarded a full assistantship by their department are not eligible
US citizens and permanent residents, including dual US citizenship combined with citizenship of a member economy, are not eligible
Graduate applicants: first university degree obtained by the time of application to the scholarship and a GPA above the university's minimum standard
Undergraduate applicants: first two years of the undergraduate degree completed, or an Associate's degree, and a GPA above the university's minimum standard
Language competence to undertake studies in the language of instruction, and good physical and mental health
requirements: Be admitted to a degree-seeking on-campus programme at the Fort Collins campus for Fall 2027
Complete the OAS Scholarship Application - Colorado State University form on the CSU International Enrollment Center page
Answer the eligibility screening questions (new-student status, student type, OAS citizenship, dual US citizenship or permanent residency)
Provide name, preferred first name, email, CSU ID, date of birth and mailing address
Write two essay responses of 2-3 paragraphs each: why you chose to apply to CSU, and your career goals and how a CSU degree helps you reach them
documents: CSU ID issued when the CSU application account was created (found via RamWeb if needed)
Evidence of admission to a degree-seeking on-campus programme for Fall 2027
Two essay responses entered directly into the OAS Scholarship Application form
Contact details as requested by the form
selection_criteria: CSU and the OAS administer selection jointly; the pages publish no scoring thresholds
Students who qualify for both the OAS Scholarship and the APEC scholarship can receive only one award - the higher of the two
coverage: One third off non-resident tuition for all degree-seeking on-campus programmes; no living-cost, travel or other support is published
application_method: Apply and be admitted to Colorado State University Fort Collins for Fall 2027
Complete the 'OAS Scholarship Application - Colorado State University' form on the CSU International Enrollment Center page
Impact MBA applicants are considered after acceptance into the MBA, which starts annually in August
Contact international@colostate.edu for more information about applying
official.application_route: Be admitted to CSU Fort Collins for Fall 2027 first, then complete the brief OAS Scholarship Application form on the CSU International Enrollment Center page.
official.study_mode: Degree-seeking, on-campus programme at the Fort Collins campus
official.citizenship_residency: Citizens or permanent residents of the 32 listed OAS member economies; US citizens and permanent residents, including dual nationals, are excluded
official.international_eligibility: Open to international students from OAS member economies other than the United States; US citizens and permanent residents are not eligible
official.duration: Follows the length of the degree pursued; the Impact MBA starts annually in August
official.description: In partnership with the Organization of American States, Colorado State University offers scholarships to qualified candidates of the Americas to participate in on-campus academic programs at CSU, awarding one third off non-resident tuition for all degree-seeking on-campus programmes.
official.program_type: Regional intergovernmental scholarship (OAS Partnerships Program for Education and Training, PAEC) hosted by Colorado State University
official.english_requirement: Possess the language competence to undertake studies in the language of the institution in the country of study (published wording; no test or score is stated)

not_confirmed: funding_amount / funding_currency - no monetary figure is published; the award is a proportional one-third discount of non-resident tuition
deadline_central - no single closing date is published (rolling admission for bachelor's; graduate deadlines vary)
living_cost_coverage and travel_coverage - no living or travel support is published
verification.notes: CSU International Enrollment Center page and the OAS scholarships page were read in full on 2026-10-10; the '1/3 off non-resident tuition' wording comes from the CSU page, and the OAS page confirms the programme as an open 2026 PAEC announcement with rolling bachelor's admission and varying graduate deadlines.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a tuition discount, not a living scholarship: you must first win admission to a Fort Collins degree programme for Fall 2027, then file the short CSU form with two 2-3 paragraph essays. Because the discount only touches non-resident tuition, budget for living costs in Fort Collins yourself, and note that holding a full departmental assistantship disqualifies you from this award.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Transfer undergraduate and graduate applicants from OAS member states (except the US) admitted to Fort Collins on-campus degrees who lack full departmental assistantship funding.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure CSU admission for Fall 2027 before touching the scholarship form - admission is the gate, not the scholarship
Locate your CSU ID from RamWeb (issued when you created your CSU application account)
Draft the two essays (why CSU; career goals) before opening the form, since answers are typed directly into it
Confirm you are a transfer undergraduate or graduate student - new first-year applicants are screened out
Check that you have no full departmental assistantship, since that voids eligibility
Email international@colostate.edu to confirm graduate admission deadlines, which vary by programme
common_rejection_risks: Applying as a new first-year student instead of a transfer undergraduate or graduate student
Holding dual US citizenship or US permanent residence alongside OAS member-state citizenship - an automatic exclusion
Being admitted to the SPUR campus programme, whose discounted tuition already excludes the award
Holding a full departmental assistantship, which makes you ineligible outright
Expecting the award to cover living costs - it reduces tuition only, so visa funding proofs still rest on you
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs, housing, insurance and travel to Fort Collins; the two-thirds of non-resident tuition not discounted; any mandatory fees not classed as tuition.
document_audit: The form asks for your CSU ID, not your application number - it is issued when you create the CSU application account and is visible in RamWeb
Essays are typed into the web form itself, so prepare them as plain text in advance rather than as attachments
Impact MBA applicants apply only after acceptance into the MBA; the scholarship is not a route into the programme
alerts: Only newly admitted students for Fall 2027 are considered, so students already taking classes at CSU cannot apply this round
No closing date is published: bachelor's admission is rolling, and graduate deadlines vary by programme - confirm your programme's date early
A student qualifying for both the OAS and APEC awards receives only one - the higher - so do not count on stacking them
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Admission first, then the short online OAS Scholarship Application on the CSU IEC page; CSU and the OAS administer selection and notify recipients through their CSU channel.
